newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jan-May direct financing falls 7.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jan-May direct financing falls 7.7 pct.

text.p: South Korea's direct financing -- funds raised on the stock and bond markets -- fell 7.7 percent to 13.27 trillion won in the first five months of this year from 14.38 trillion a year ago, the Securities Supervisory Board (SSB) said on Monday.
The SSB said funds raised in the stock market in the five-month period totalled 657.9 billion won, down 53.7 percent from 1.42 trillion won a year before.
The board attributed the fall to a slump in the stock market and lacklustre capital investment.
Funds raised through rights issues amounted to 559.8 billion won, compared with 1.16 trillion won, the board said.
It said financing through issues of corporate bonds fell 2.6 percent to 12.61 trillion won from 12.96 trillion, it said.
